title: Open Field Exploration: Locomotor Activity and Anxiety Assessment in Mice
author: Sarah van Veen

steps.title: Acclimatize Mice
steps.instruction: Place each mouse in a dark holding space or covered holding cage adjacent to the test room for 30 min immediately before testing.

steps.title: Initiate Open-Field Exploration
steps.instruction: Transfer the mouse gently to a corner of the open-field arena and start ANY-maze recording immediately.

steps.title: Record Locomotor and Anxiety Behavior
steps.instruction: Allow the mouse free exploration for 10 min while ANY-maze automatically tracks position and computes specific indices.

substeps.instruction: Track total path length (cm) and corner crossings as locomotor activity indices.
Track entries into the centre as a measure of conflict resolution or anxiolysis.

steps.title: Clean Arena Between Trials
steps.instruction: Return the mouse to its home cage and prepare the arena for the next subject.

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly clean the arena floor and walls with 70% ethanol.
Allow ethanol to fully evaporate before placing the next mouse.

steps.title: Export and Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Export the recorded metrics from ANY-maze and perform statistical analysis.

substeps.instruction: Export total path length, corner crossings, and centre entries for each animal.
Apply appropriate statistical tests comparing WT vs KO.
